title: Mallrats
tagline: Dumped. Go to the mall. Eat.
about: Two friends dumped on the same day spend it hanging around the local mall.

    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersFood court pretzelsSoft bite-size pretzels rolled in cinnamon sugar with sweetened cream cheeseHow to make it500g plain flour7g dried yeast300ml warm water2 tbsp bicarb soda60g butter, melted100g caster sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon250g cream cheese, sweetened to tasteMix the flour, yeast and warm water to a dough and knead briefly.Rest the dough for an hour until puffy.Cut into bites and boil briefly in water with the bicarb soda.Bake at 220°C for 12 minutes until deep golden.Brush with butter and roll in cinnamon sugar. Serve with the sweetened cream cheese.Comic store popcornButtered popcorn tossed with parmesan and garlic powderHow to make it100g popping corn60g butter, melted50g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp garlic powderPop the corn and toss straight away with the melted butter.Sprinkle with parmesan and garlic powder, tossing until every piece is coated. Pour into paper bags.Food court pork egg rollsThe fast food stalls around the food courtHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pork, cabbage, carrot and spring onion rolled tight in egg roll wrappers, fried crisp and blistered, sliced on the angle with sweet and sour sauce.Stir-fry 300g pork mince with 2 garlic cloves and grated ginger until browned.Add 3 cups shredded cabbage, a grated carrot and 3 spring onions and cook 3 minutes.Season with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil, then cool.Roll tightly in 12 large spring roll wrappers, sealing with water.Fry at 180°C for 4 minutes until golden.Slice on the angle and serve with sweet and sour sauce.MainsEden Prairie food court teriyaki chickenGlazed grilled chicken thighs over jasmine rice with stir-fried broccoliHow to make it800g chicken thighs120ml soy sauce120ml mirin2 tbsp sugar1 tbsp grated ginger300g jasmine rice2 heads of broccoli, cut into floretsSimmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger until syrupy.Steam the rice. Grill the chicken, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.Stir-fry the broccoli quickly. Slice the chicken over the rice and spoon over the extra sauce.Game show pepperoni mushroom pizzaThe dating game show in the middle of the mallHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin pizza bases spread with garlic tomato sauce, loaded with mozzarella, pepperoni, mushrooms and oregano, baked blistering hot and cut into squares.Blitz a 400g can of tomatoes with a garlic clove, 1 tsp oregano, salt and olive oil.Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases on oiled trays.Spread with the sauce, then top with 250g grated mozzarella, 120g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms.Bake at 250°C, or the hottest your oven goes, for 10 minutes until blistered.Scatter with chilli flakes and cut into squares.SweetsSailboat poster cookiesBig chocolate chip cookies with gooey centres, served warmHow to make it125g butter, soft150g brown sugar1 egg225g plain flour200g dark chocolate chipsBeat the butter, sugar and egg until creamy. Mix in the flour and chocolate chips.Roll into big balls and bake at 180°C so the centres stay gooey.Cool for 5 minutes and serve warm.DrinksTruth or Date lemonadeMuddled strawberries, lemon juice and soda water over iceHow to make it250g strawberries6 lemons, juiced100g caster sugar, to taste1 L cold soda water1 bag iceMuddle the strawberries in the bottom of a big jug.Add the lemon juice and sugar to taste, then top with soda water.Pour into big cups packed with ice and add a straw to each.
